lenses.title: Contract fidelity
lenses.instructions: Compare every target claim to the authoritative contract and report only observable contradictions or omissions.

lenses.title: Boundary and failure cases
lenses.instructions: Check malformed, missing, empty, and boundary inputs against the target's stated behavior.

lenses.title: Internal consistency
lenses.instructions: Check repeated names, values, references, and examples for contradictions inside the target.

lenses.title: Dependency contracts
lenses.instructions: Check every target assumption about a dependency against the manifest-selected binding contract and report missing or invented guarantees.

lenses.title: Operational completeness
lenses.instructions: Check whether a consumer can apply the target without hidden prerequisites, ambiguous outputs, or unspecified recovery behavior.
